searchText: The payload is opaque to 2718, so it can be encoded however the transaction type wants. The payload bytes can be RLP, or SSZ, or UTF8 JSON, etc. Basically 2718 is just saying that the 2718 specification is unopinionated about the encoding of the payload. Thanks <@301186049323958275>
